customManagers.description: Keep the app version in lockstep with the Bitwarden lite image tag

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, merged automatically once CI passes
Bitwarden lite: Dockerfile tag + digest and config.yaml version in one PR
prBodyNotes: Before merging: add a `## {{{newVersion}}}` section to `bitwarden_lite/CHANGELOG.md` (the version check fails until you do). See RELEASING.md.

packageRules.description: Tailscale and cloudflared: one grouped PR; needs a packaging revision
prBodyNotes: Before merging: bump `version` in `bitwarden_lite/config.yaml` to the next packaging revision (the version check names it) and add a CHANGELOG entry. See RELEASING.md.
